title: UniDynamics: Event-RGB Fusion for Unified Future 4D Dynamic Scene Generation
title_zh: UniDynamics: 事件-RGB融合以实现统一的未来4D动态场景生成

paragraphs.en: We propose UniDynamics , a diffusion-based framework for future 4D dynamic scenes (RGB, depth, and optical flow) generation from a single event-RGB pair, without requiring long histories or control priors as in existing methods, while explicitly modeling future motion fields. The core idea is to leverage event streams to offer an alternative motion prior for single-RGB extrapolation, and to enforce geometric and motion constraints throughout generation via multimodal modeling. Specifically, we design an Event Latent Enhancement (ELE) module to align and enhance event latents into diffusion-injectable conditioning features, providing robust initial motion priors and reliable texture/structure cues. We further introduce a Perceptual Dynamics Space (PDS) embedded in the multi-scale U-Net, which decouples and adaptively interacts depth and flow while continuously feeding back constraints to appearance features, improving geometric-motion consistency for physically plausible and spatiotemporally coherent prediction. Experiments on VKitti2 and DSEC demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, producing high-quality, temporally coherent, and 4D-consistent future predictions, especially under challenging high-speed motion blur.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 UniDynamics——一种基于扩散模型的未来 4D 动态场景（RGB、深度和光流）生成框架，仅需单个事件-RGB 对即可生成，无需像现有方法那样依赖长时间的历史数据或控制先验，同时还能显式建模未来的运动场。 其核心思想是利用事件流为单 RGB 图像的外推提供替代的运动先验，并通过多模态建模在整个生成过程中强制执行几何和运动约束。 具体而言，我们设计了一个事件潜在增强（ELE）模块，用于对齐并增强事件潜在表示，将其转化为可注入扩散模型的条件特征，从而提供稳健的初始运动先验以及可靠的纹理与结构线索。 我们还进一步在多层级 U-Net 中引入了感知动态空间（PDS），该模块能够解耦并自适应地交互深度与光流，同时持续将约束反馈至外观特征，从而提升几何与运动的一致性，实现物理上合理且时空连贯的预测。 在 VKitti2 和 DSEC 数据集上的实验表明，该方法达到了当前最先进的性能，能够生成高质量、时间连贯且 4D 一致的未来预测结果，尤其是在具有挑战性的高速运动模糊场景下表现优异。

paragraphs.en: In autonomous driving scenarios, the ability of infering the evolution of the environment over time and understand future scenes based on current visual observations is critical for autonomous systems. It serves as an essential foundation for motion planning [ 15 ] , obstacle avoidance [ 37 ] , and risk-aware decision [ 33 ] .

paragraphs.en: Some existing works focus on generative driving world models [ 8 , 40 , 13 , 24 , 14 , 43 ] , which leverage the current frame or historical observations and introduce conditions such as trajectories, velocities, or text to improve controllability of future generations. However, the reliance on additional conditioning signals substantially increases system complexity and adaptation cost. In contrast, vision-only video prediction methods [ 21 ] model the temporal evolution of semantic features from pretrained video foundation models, better matching the need for a “plug-and-play” perception front-end, but their fine-grained fidelity is often inferior to generative approaches. More importantly, in real-world open-road deployment, long video histories and consistent structured priors are not always reliably available, making a more practical and transferable setting that uses only a single current frame as the minimal input. Recent Unifuture [ 24 ] extrapolates future scenes under single-frame conditioning by leveraging motion-prior conditions (e.g., velocity, acceleration, and trajectory). However, without such priors, scene dynamics are unobservable, and motion blur further degrades appearance cues, leading to erroneous extrapolation (see UniFuture in Fig. 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 一些现有研究专注于生成式驾驶世界模型 [ 8 , 40 , 13 , 24 , 14 , 43 ]，这些模型利用当前帧或历史观测数据，并引入轨迹、速度或文本等条件，以提升未来生成内容的可控性。 然而，对额外条件信号的依赖显著增加了系统的复杂性和适应成本。 相比之下，仅基于视觉的视频预测方法 [ 21 ] 通过预训练视频基础模型来建模语义特征的时序演化，更符合“即插即用”感知前端的需求，但其精细保真度通常低于生成式方法。 更重要的是，在真实世界的开放道路部署中，长视频历史数据和一致的结构化先验并不总能可靠获取，因此一个更实用且更具迁移能力的方案是仅使用单个当前帧作为最小输入。 近期的 Unifuture [ 24 ] 通过利用运动先验条件（例如速度、加速度和轨迹），在单帧条件下外推未来场景。 然而，若缺乏此类先验，场景动态便无法被观测到，而运动模糊还会进一步削弱外观线索，从而导致错误的外推（参见图 1 中的 UniFuture）。

paragraphs.en: Notably, the inherent temporal sensitivity of event cameras [ 25 , 1 ] provides directional and boundary motion cues, offering an alternative motion prior for future extrapolation under single-frame conditioning. In particular, event streams offer continuous motion observations without requiring long histories, and remain informative even under fast-motion blur, providing stable initial momentum and structural cues. We therefore argue that event streams provide a more stable and blur-robust motion prior, enabling reliable future extrapolation even under single-frame conditioning. In addition, the above methods often restrict prediction to static RGB appearance [ 8 , 40 , 14 ] or depth geometry [ 24 , 13 , 21 ] and lack explicit motion-field modeling, which is crucial for assessing scene dynamics, interaction risks, and potential collisions [ 16 ] , and serves as a key constraint for physically consistent and temporally coherent future-scene prediction and percption.
paragraphs.zh: 值得注意的是，事件相机的内在时间敏感性 [25, 1] 提供了方向性和边界运动线索，为单帧条件下的未来外推提供了另一种运动先验。 特别地，事件流无需依赖长时间的历史数据即可提供连续的运动观测信息，即使在高速运动模糊的情况下仍能保留有效信息，从而提供稳定的初始动量和结构线索。 因此我们认为，事件流能够提供更稳定且对运动模糊更具鲁棒性的运动先验，即便在单帧条件下也能实现可靠的未来外推。 此外，上述方法通常将预测限制在静态的 RGB 外观 [8, 40, 14] 或深度几何结构 [24, 13, 21] 上，且缺乏对运动场的显式建模；而运动场对于评估场景动态、交互风险及潜在碰撞至关重要 [16]，也是实现物理一致且时间连贯的未来场景预测与感知的关键约束。

paragraphs.en: To this end, we propose UniDynamics , a diffusion-based RGB, depth, and optical flow predicting framework with an event-RGB pair observation, as illustrated in Fig. 1 . The core of our approach lies in event-guided condition enhancement and multimodal jointly interacting and predicting. Specifically, we treat the event stream as complementary to the RGB observation and introduce an Event Latent Enhancement (ELE) module to encode it into the event latent. To obtain stable and generalizable event cues, we use the RGB latent as an appearance reference and align/enhance the event latent via cross-attention layers, yielding a condition that provides initial momentum and texture/boundary cues while remaining compatible with RGB-pretrained SVD [ 2 ] . Since appearance, geometry, and motion are heterogeneous views of the same scene, we adopt the latent space of a pretrained image autoencoder as a shared alignment domain, diffuse on the image latent, and derive depth and flow from it, avoiding modality-specific encoders and improving cross-modal alignment. We further embed a Perceptual Dynamics Space (PDS) into the multi-scale U-Net to enable continuous interaction between geometry/motion priors and appearance features. Task-specific adapters and gated interactions in PDS decouple depth and flow to reduce multi-task interference and suppress flow-induced structural perturbations, improving temporal coherence while preserving stable structure.
paragraphs.zh: 为此，我们提出了 UniDynamics——一种基于扩散模型、能够预测 RGB、深度和光流信息的框架，其输入为事件-RGB 对观测数据，如图 1 所示。 我们方法的核心在于事件引导的条件增强，以及多模态信息的联合交互与预测。 具体而言，我们将事件流视为对 RGB 观测数据的补充，并引入一个事件潜在增强（ELE）模块，将其编码为事件潜在表示。 为了获得稳定且具备泛化能力的线索，我们以 RGB 潜在表示作为外观参考，通过交叉注意力层对齐和增强事件潜在表示，从而生成一种条件：该条件既能提供初始动量和纹理/边界线索，又能与基于 RGB 预训练的 SVD [2] 保持兼容。 由于外观、几何结构和运动是对同一场景的不同异质视角，我们采用预训练图像自编码器的潜在空间作为共享对齐域，在该图像潜在表示上进行扩散，并从中推导出深度和光流，从而避免使用模态特定的编码器，并提升跨模态对齐效果。 我们进一步在多层级 U-Net 中嵌入感知动力学空间（PDS），以实现几何/运动先验与外观特征之间的持续交互。 PDS 中的任务特定适配器和门控交互机制能够解耦深度与光流，从而减少多任务间的干扰，并抑制由光流引起的结构扰动，在保持结构稳定的同时提升时间连贯性。

paragraphs.en: RGB-based Future Scene Prediction Methods. Future scene prediction from visual observations is critical for autonomous driving. Generic video prediction methods [ 41 , 9 , 35 ] are mostly developed on general datasets and often transfer poorly to driving scenarios. Driving-focused generative world models [ 14 , 40 , 8 , 23 , 43 , 18 ] improve controllability by introducing additional conditions such as actions, text, trajectories, and other priors, and some further model RGB with depth [ 24 , 13 ] . However, the reliance on extra structured conditions increases system complexity and adaptation cost. Vision-only prediction methods based on CNN/RNN, masked modeling, or foundation models [ 26 , 4 , 20 , 21 ] avoid extra priors, but typically have lower fine-grained fidelity and often require long histories, incurring memory and latency. However, in deployment-relevant single-frame settings, scene dynamics are difficult to capture, and appearance cues are often degraded under fast motion. Meanwhile, most methods lack explicit motion-field modeling, limiting effective spatiotemporal consistency constraints. Motivated by these gaps, we introduce event streams as dynamic observations for the deployment-relevant settings, and adopt a diffusion framework to jointly predict RGB, depth, and optical flow for physically plausible and spatiotemporally coherent 4D scene generation and perception.
paragraphs.zh: 基于RGB的未来场景预测方法。 从视觉观察中预测未来场景对自动驾驶至关重要。 通用的视频预测方法 [ 41 , 9 , 35 ] 大多在通用数据集上开发，且通常难以有效迁移到驾驶场景。 以驾驶为焦点的生成式世界模型 [ 14 , 40 , 8 , 23 , 43 , 18 ] 通过引入动作、文本、轨迹和其他先验等额外条件来增强可控性，其中一些方法还进一步将RGB与深度信息结合 [ 24 , 13 ] 。 然而，对额外结构化条件的依赖会增加系统复杂性和适应成本。 基于CNN/RNN、掩码建模或基础模型的纯视觉预测方法 [ 26 , 4 , 20 , 21 ] 避免了额外先验，但通常精细度较低，且常需要较长的历史数据，从而带来内存和延迟问题。 然而，在实际部署相关的单帧设置中，场景动态难以捕捉，外观线索在快速运动下也常常受到削弱。 同时，大多数方法缺乏显式的运动场建模，限制了有效的时空一致性约束。 基于这些不足，我们引入事件流作为实际部署场景中的动态观察数据，并采用扩散框架联合预测RGB、深度和光流，以生成物理上合理且时空连贯的4D场景，实现场景生成与感知。

paragraphs.en: Event-based Future Scene Prediction Methods. Compared to conventional cameras, event cameras provide reliable motion observations for predicting in dynamic scenes. Recent works [ 42 , 22 , 5 ] validate the effectiveness of events for temporal extrapolation. E-Motion [ 42 ] combines the high temporal resolution of events with video diffusion to predict future event frames, while F 3 F^{3} [ 5 ] learns predictive representations by predicting events and transferring them to tasks such as optical flow and semantic segmentation. However, event-only methods often break down in static or low-texture regions due to the dynamic characteristics and sparsity of events. DESSERT [ 22 ] fuses events with RGB for diffusion-based single-frame prediction, but long-horizon prediction suffers from error accumulation. Moreover, these methods also lack explicit motion-field modeling. Therefore, we exploit the complementarity of events and RGB and jointly model 4D scenes to achieve temporally coherent future evolution.
paragraphs.zh: 基于事件的未来场景预测方法。 与传统相机相比，事件相机能够为动态场景的预测提供可靠的运动观测信息。 近期的研究 [ 42 , 22 , 5 ] 验证了事件在时间外推方面的有效性。 E-Motion [ 42 ] 将事件的高时间分辨率与视频扩散模型相结合，以预测未来的事件帧；而 F 3 F^{3} [ 5 ] 则通过预测事件并将其迁移到光流和语义分割等任务中，来学习预测性表示。 然而，仅依赖事件的方法常常在静态或低纹理区域失效，这是由事件的动态特性和稀疏性所导致的。 DESSERT [ 22 ] 将事件与 RGB 图像融合，用于基于扩散的单帧预测，但长期预测会因误差累积而受到影响。 此外，这些方法也缺乏对运动场的显式建模。 因此，我们利用事件与 RGB 图像之间的互补性，并联合建模 4D 场景，以实现时间上连贯的未来演化预测。

paragraphs.en: Event-RGB-fusion-based Vsion Tasks Monocular depth and optical flow estimation are core vision tasks for autonomous driving. Since events and frames offer complementary temporal and appearance cues, many works fuse them to improve robustness and accuracy. Early works on event–RGB depth estimation make efforts on using recurrent fusion [ 10 ] , flow-based compensation [ 32 ] , and cross-modal consistency with pseudo-supervision [ 47 ] . Later methods improve fusion robustness via structural priors [ 29 ] , high-level pattern/token interactions [ 27 ] , cross-modal attention with multi-scale interaction [ 6 , 19 ] , or frequency-domain fusion [ 34 ] . For optical flow, several approaches extend RAFT [ 36 ] to fuse events and RGB, while DCEIFlow [ 38 ] and BFlow [ 12 ] estimate dense continuous-time motion, and STFlow [ 44 ] narrows the modality gap with spatially guided temporal aggregation. Diffusion-based fusion [ 39 ] is also explored by incorporating events into FlowDiffuser [ 28 ] for challenging conditions. Although these methods target current/past perception rather than prediction, they consistently demonstrate the complementarity of RGB–event fusion, motivating our event–RGB scheme for future scene prediction.
paragraphs.zh: 基于事件-RGB融合的视觉任务：单目深度和光流估计是自动驾驶的核心视觉任务。 由于事件和帧提供了互补的时间与外观线索，许多研究通过融合二者来提升鲁棒性和准确性。 早期关于事件-RGB深度估计的研究尝试了循环融合 [10]、基于光流的补偿 [32]，以及结合伪监督的跨模态一致性方法 [47]。 后续方法通过结构先验 [29]、高层模式/标记交互 [27]、结合多尺度交互的跨模态注意力 [6, 19]，或频域融合 [34] 提升了融合的鲁棒性。 在光流方面，多种方法扩展了 RAFT [36] 以融合事件和RGB数据；而 DCEIFlow [38] 和 BFlow [12] 则估计了密集且连续时间的运动，STFlow [44] 通过空间引导的时间聚合缩小了模态差异。 研究也探索了基于扩散的融合方法 [39]，通过将事件整合到 FlowDiffuser [28] 中，以应对复杂场景。 尽管这些方法针对的是当前或过去的感知而非预测，但它们一致证明了RGB-事件融合的互补性，这也启发我们提出了用于未来场景预测的事件-RGB方案。

paragraphs.en: Stable Video Diffusion (SVD) [ 2 ] generates high-fidelity videos via latent diffusion. It encodes frames into a VAE latent space, progressively adds Gaussian noise to the target latent sequence during training, and optimizes a spatiotemporal U-Net to learn the reverse denoising process conditioned on the input-frame latent. At inference, it starts from Gaussian noise, iteratively denoises under the same conditioning, and decodes the resulting latents into video frames. Leveraging high-fidelity generation of SVD, recent works [ 40 , 8 , 24 , 13 ] synthesize realistic future driving scenes and even extend to geometry-aware prediction [ 24 , 13 ] . However, under the deployment-relevant single-frame setting, where initial motion cues cannot be provided, future extrapolation becomes highly ill-posed, and limited dynamics modeling further restricts temporal coherence.
paragraphs.zh: Stable Video Diffusion (SVD) [ 2 ] 通过潜在扩散生成高保真视频。 它将帧编码到 VAE 潜在空间中，在训练过程中逐步向目标潜在序列添加高斯噪声，并优化一个时空 U-Net 以学习基于输入帧潜条件的反向去噪过程。 在推理阶段，它从高斯噪声开始，在相同条件下迭代去噪，并将生成的潜在变量解码为视频帧。 利用 SVD 的高保真生成能力，近期的研究 [ 40 , 8 , 24 , 13 ] 合成了逼真的未来驾驶场景，甚至扩展到了几何感知预测 [ 24 , 13 ] 。 然而，在部署相关的单帧设置中，由于无法提供初始运动线索，未来外推变得高度不适定，而有限的动态建模进一步限制了时间连贯性。

paragraphs.en: We propose UniDynamics , a diffusion-based framework for future 4D scene generation, as illustrated in Fig. 2 . Given the current frame at time T T and corresponding event stream ℰ T − 1 → T \mathcal{E}_{T-1\to T} , we build on SVD as the generative backbone and aim to predict the future N N -frame RGB sequence along with the depth maps and optical flows. Since RGB, depth, and optical flow provide complementary views of the same scene, we adopt the latent space of a pretrained image VAE encoder 𝑬 V \bm{E}_{V} as a unified representation. The diffusion backbone generates future appearance only in the image latent Z ⁡ ( I ) Z(I) , while depth and flow latents are initialized from Z ⁡ ( I ) Z(I) and progressively refined through multi-scale U-Net interactions, enabling joint modeling of appearance, geometry, and motion in a shared latent space. This avoids training extra encoders, promotes cross-modal alignment, and allows lightweight networks to translate between modalities. To provide initial momentum under single-frame conditioning and support joint multimodal generation, our architecture comprises two key components. (1) Event latent guided motion conditioning. We extract motion cues from the event stream and employ an Event Latent Enhancement module to produce a diffusion-injectable conditioning feature Z ⁡ ( E ) Z(E) , providing stable motion signals and rich texture/boundary priors that complement RGB. (2) Perceptual Dynamics Space for depth and flow modeling. To capture the coupled evolution of appearance, geometry, and motion in future scenes, we introduce the Perceptual Dynamics Space (PDS), a multi-scale interaction module embedded within the U-Net. PDS jointly models depth and optical-flow latents and performs bidirectional feature exchange with the diffusion backbone to impose multimodal consistency and refine the generated predictions. Finally, the predicted latent codes Z ^ ​ ( I ) \hat{Z}(I) , Z ^ ​ ( D ) \hat{Z}(D) , and Z ^ ​ ( F ) \hat{Z}(F) are decoded by the shared VAE decoder 𝑫 V \bm{D}_{V} into RGB frames, depth maps, and optical flow, enabling joint generation of future 4D scenes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 UniDynamics，这是一种基于扩散模型的未来 4D 场景生成框架，如图 2 所示。 给定时间 T 的当前帧以及对应的事件流 ℰ T − 1 → T \mathcal{E}_{T-1\to T}，我们以 SVD 作为生成主干，旨在预测未来 N 帧的 RGB 序列，同时生成深度图和光流。 由于 RGB、深度和光流提供了同一场景的互补视角，我们采用预训练图像 VAE 编码器 𝑬 V \bm{E}_{V} 的潜在空间作为统一表示。 扩散主干仅在图像潜在空间 Z ⁡ ( I ) Z(I) 中生成未来的外观，而深度和光流的潜在变量则从 Z ⁡ ( I ) Z(I) 初始化，并通过多尺度 U-Net 交互逐步优化，从而在共享的潜在空间中联合建模外观、几何和运动。 这避免了训练额外的编码器，促进了跨模态对齐，并允许轻量级网络在不同模态之间进行转换。 为了在单帧条件下提供初始动量并支持联合多模态生成，我们的架构包含两个关键组件。 (1) 事件潜在引导的运动条件约束。 我们从事件流中提取运动线索，并使用事件潜在增强模块生成可注入扩散模型的条件特征 Z ⁡ ( E ) Z(E)，从而提供稳定的运动信号以及丰富的纹理和边界先验，以补充 RGB 信息。 (2) 用于深度和光流建模的感知动力学空间。 为了捕捉未来场景中外观、几何和运动的耦合演化，我们引入了感知动力学空间（PDS），这是一个嵌入在 U-Net 中的多尺度交互模块。 PDS 联合建模深度和光流的潜在变量，并与扩散主干进行双向特征交换，以施加多模态一致性并优化生成的预测结果。 最后，预测的潜在编码 Z ^ ​ ( I ) \hat{Z}(I)、Z ^ ​ ( D ) \hat{Z}(D) 和 Z ^ ​ ( F ) \hat{Z}(F) 由共享的 VAE 解码器 𝑫 V \bm{D}_{V} 解码为 RGB 帧、深度图和光流，从而实现未来 4D 场景的联合生成。

sents.en: This avoids training extra encoders, promotes cross-modal alignment, and allows lightweight networks to translate between modalities.
sents.zh: 这避免了训练额外的编码器，促进了跨模态对齐，并允许轻量级网络在不同模态之间进行转换。

sents.en: To provide initial momentum under single-frame conditioning and support joint multimodal generation, our architecture comprises two key components.
sents.zh: 为了在单帧条件下提供初始动量并支持联合多模态生成，我们的架构包含两个关键组件。

sents.en: (1) Event latent guided motion conditioning.
sents.zh: (1) 事件潜在引导的运动条件约束。

sents.en: We extract motion cues from the event stream and employ an Event Latent Enhancement module to produce a diffusion-injectable conditioning feature Z ⁡ ( E ) Z(E) , providing stable motion signals and rich texture/boundary priors that complement RGB.
sents.zh: 我们从事件流中提取运动线索，并使用事件潜在增强模块生成可注入扩散模型的条件特征 Z ⁡ ( E ) Z(E)，从而提供稳定的运动信号以及丰富的纹理和边界先验，以补充 RGB 信息。

sents.en: (2) Perceptual Dynamics Space for depth and flow modeling.
sents.zh: (2) 用于深度和光流建模的感知动力学空间。

sents.en: To capture the coupled evolution of appearance, geometry, and motion in future scenes, we introduce the Perceptual Dynamics Space (PDS), a multi-scale interaction module embedded within the U-Net.
sents.zh: 为了捕捉未来场景中外观、几何和运动的耦合演化，我们引入了感知动力学空间（PDS），这是一个嵌入在 U-Net 中的多尺度交互模块。

sents.en: PDS jointly models depth and optical-flow latents and performs bidirectional feature exchange with the diffusion backbone to impose multimodal consistency and refine the generated predictions.
sents.zh: PDS 联合建模深度和光流的潜在变量，并与扩散主干进行双向特征交换，以施加多模态一致性并优化生成的预测结果。

paragraphs.en: Since the event latent primarily encodes short-term motion, directly concatenating Z ⁡ ( E ) Z(E) with future noise latents as a strong condition for all future steps (as done for RGB latents) may overly entangle transient cues with global scene evolution, introducing bias and causing structural artifacts, temporal drift, or long-horizon overfitting. paragraphs.en: Datasets. We train and evaluate on the driving dataset E-VKitti2 [ 7 ] , and conduct zero-shot testing on real-world DSEC [ 11 ] , MVSEC [ 45 ] , and M3ED [ 3 ] datasets to assess generalization. VKitti2 provides high-quality synthetic RGB images, depth maps, and optical flow across diverse driving scenarios and appearance conditions (e.g., varying illumination). We use v2e [ 17 ] to synthesize E-VKitti2 dataset. DSEC is a real-world event-camera dataset containing RGB frames, event streams, disparity, and optical flow under different lighting and dynamic scenes. We convert the official disparity maps to depth using the provided conversion code. The o ​ u ​ t ​ d ​ o ​ o ​ r ​ _ ​ d ​ a ​ y ​ 1 outdoor\_day1 sequence of the MVSEC provides relatively sparse events, enabling evaluation of generalization under weak event cues. Moreover, the M3ED features complex and dynamic outdoor scenes. To further evaluate performance under high-speed motion, we apply flow-based motion blur on E-VKitti2 to emulate image blur, where the prediction target is the corresponding deblured RGB.

paragraphs.en: The results show that only our method supports the simultaneous generation of future RGB, depth, and optical flow. Moreover, diffusion-based methods show overall superiority over non-diffusion-based methods in terms of both video generation and future perception. Comparing Vista with UniDynamics (w/o events) verifies that additionally modeling depth and flow to guide RGB synthesis significantly improves generation quality (from 101.8 to 46.8 on FID) and spatiotemporal coherence (from 1364.6 to 577.1 on FVD). Meanwhile, the results of UniDynamics (w/o RGB) show that event-only prediction can still outperform Vista. However, due to the absence of rich appearance references, it yields lower generation quality and perception accuracy than the full UniDynamics model. Compared with UniFuture variants and UniDynamics (w/o events) , our method achieves slightly better FID, delivers a clear gain in RGB temporal coherence, and also yields stronger performance on the perception tasks. These gains stem from leveraging events to provide initial motion cues and rich texture/structure information, together with the PDS module that enables continuous depth–flow–RGB interaction. Overall, our method delivers higher-fidelity (the lowest FID of 39.1) and more coherent RGB generates (the lowest FVD of 223.6), more accurate and structurally consistent depth, and lower-error, more robust optical flow, demonstrating the effectiveness of event-guided multimodal modeling for future scene generation and perception.

paragraphs.en: As shown in Fig. 5 , UniDynamics generates RGB frames that better follow realistic scene evolution, leading to more accurate depth and flow predictions that capture scene geometry and motion more faithfully. In contrast, the baselines produce RGB frames with incorrect motion, resulting in less accurate depth and optical flow. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of our event-guided joint RGB–depth–flow modeling for coherent future forecasting and perception. Moreover, Fig. 6 visualizes the 3D point clouds reconstructed from the predicted RGB and depth, as well as the scene flow derived from the predicted optical flow. The reconstructions and scene flow closely match the ground truth in overall structure and motion trends, indicating that UniDynamics has the potential to enable 4D scene reconstruction of future worlds. paragraphs.en: Robustness under Motion Blur. We evaluate robustness to motion blur on E-VKitti2 by simulating image degradation under high-speed motion. Tab. 2 compares our method with the strongest baseline UniFuture and our ablation UniDynamics (w/o events) . With a single blurred RGB input, the UniFuture family and UniDynamics (w/o events) perform poorly on all generation and perception metrics, consistent with the qualitative comparison in Fig. 1 . Such challenging scenarios lack a reliable appearance reference, which degrades generation quality as well as depth/flow estimation accuracy. These results indicate that event signals can provide effective texture and structural cues to compensate for blurred RGB in high-speed scenes, and that multimodal joint modeling is crucial for robust future prediction.

paragraphs.en: Zero-shot on real-world datasets. We evaluate cross-domain and sim-to-real generalization by directly transferring the model pretrained on E-VKitti2 to three real-world datasets. As shown in Tab. 3 , although our FID is slightly inferior to UniFuture-Depth on DSEC and MVSEC, the introduction of events and optical flow substantially improves FVD performance. Moreover, our method achieves clearly better generation quality on the more complex M3ED dataset, indicating more temporally coherent and physically plausible scene evolution. In addition, our perception results improve substantially, demonstrating the effectiveness of PDS in modeling geometry and motion cues. Overall, UniDynamics generalizes well across domains and produces more coherent and accurate future 4D scene forecasts in real scenes.
paragraphs.zh: 在真实世界数据集上的零样本测试。 我们将预训练于 E-VKitti2 的模型直接迁移到三个真实世界数据集中，以评估其跨域及从模拟到真实的泛化能力。 如表 3 所示，尽管我们的 FID 在 DSEC 和 MVSEC 数据集上略逊于 UniFuture-Depth，但引入事件数据和光流显著提升了 FVD 性能。 此外，我们的方法在更复杂的 M3ED 数据集上实现了明显更优的生成质量，表明其生成的场景演化在时间上更具连贯性且物理上更可信。 同时，我们的感知结果也得到显著提升，证明了 PDS 在建模几何与运动线索方面的有效性。 总体而言，UniDynamics 在不同域间表现出良好的泛化能力，并能在真实场景中生成更具连贯性和准确性的未来 4D 场景预测。

paragraphs.en: We conduct ablation studies on E-VKitti2 [ 7 ] to verify the contribution of the key components of UniDynamics, and report the results in Tab. 4 .

paragraphs.en: Event Inputs. We remove the event input ( UniDynamics (w/o events) ) and condition the model only on a single RGB frame. The results show a substantial drop in generation quality and coherence (FID increases from 39.1 to 46.8, and FVD from 223.6 to 577.1), along with large degradations in depth and optical-flow accuracy. This confirms that events provide crucial motion cues and rich texture/structure information for guiding future scene evolution as well as geometry and motion modeling. Moreover, removing the ELE module, i.e., the “hard in” setting, and directly concatenating event features to the noisy latent variables of future frames as RGB features leads to performance degradation. This suggests that ELE effectively inject the useful motion cues and texture information of events to the diffusion process while preserving the inherent static appearance reference from RGB.
paragraphs.zh: 事件输入。 我们移除了事件输入（UniDynamics（不含事件）），并将模型仅基于单个 RGB 帧进行条件约束。 结果表明，生成质量和连贯性显著下降（FID 从 39.1 增至 46.8，FVD 从 223.6 增至 577.1），同时深度和光流精度也大幅退化。 这证实了事件为引导未来场景演化以及几何和运动建模提供了关键的运动线索和丰富的纹理/结构信息。 此外，移除 ELE 模块（即“硬性输入”设置），并将事件特征直接与未来帧的含噪潜在变量作为 RGB 特征拼接，会导致性能下降。 这表明 ELE 能够有效地将事件中包含的有用运动线索和纹理信息注入扩散过程，同时保留 RGB 提供的固有静态外观参考。

sents.zh: 这表明 ELE 能够有效地将事件中包含的有用运动线索和纹理信息注入扩散过程，同时保留 RGB 提供的固有静态外观参考。

paragraphs.en: Flow Branch. We remove the optical-flow branch ( UniDynamics-Depth ) and keep only the depth branch. Without flow, PDS no longer needs to account for flow-related gradient constraints, and since depth and RGB are both static scene descriptors, the depth branch can focus more on geometric regression, making a slight improvement reasonable. However, the model simultaneously loses an explicit motion-field constraint, so the diffusion process must infer complex long-horizon dynamics mainly from single-frame appearance and local event cues. As a result, spatiotemporal consistency and physically plausible motion propagation become harder to maintain, leading to degraded RGB FID/FVD.
paragraphs.zh: 光流分支。 我们移除了光流分支（UniDynamics-Depth），仅保留深度分支。 在没有光流的情况下，PDS 不再需要考虑与光流相关的梯度约束；由于深度和 RGB 都是静态场景描述符，深度分支可以更专注于几何回归，因此取得轻微改进是合理的。 然而，该模型同时也失去了一个显式的运动场约束，因此扩散过程必须主要基于单帧外观和局部事件线索来推断复杂的长期动态。 结果导致时空一致性和物理上合理的运动传播更难维持，进而造成 RGB FID/FVD 性能下降。

paragraphs.en: Depth Branch. Removing the depth branch ( UniDynamics-Flow ) leads to decreases in both RGB quality (FID/FVD) and optical-flow accuracy, due to the depth latent being injected as a geometry prior into the U-Net’s spatial layers, and plays a crucial role in stabilizing scene structure and boundaries throughout the diffusion process. Moreover, reliable optical flow estimation also relies on stable static structure and well-aligned motion boundaries. When geometric constraints are absent, the motion branch must estimate flow solely from the RGB latent, leading to higher EPE/AE and worse nPE metrics. Overall, depth and flow are complementary: depth stabilizes spatial structure, which benefits both appearance synthesis and motion estimation.
paragraphs.zh: 深度分支。 移除深度分支（UniDynamics-Flow）会导致 RGB 质量（FID/FVD）和光流准确性同时下降，这是因为深度潜在变量作为几何先验被注入到 U-Net 的空间层中，并在整个扩散过程中对稳定场景结构和边界起着关键作用。 此外，可靠的光流估计也依赖于稳定的静态结构和对齐良好的运动边界。 当缺乏几何约束时，运动分支必须仅从 RGB 潜在变量中估计光流，从而导致更高的 EPE/AE 和更差的 nPE 指标。 总体而言，深度和光流是互补的：深度能够稳定空间结构，这对外观合成和运动估计都有帮助。

paragraphs.en: Task Adapters in PDS. We further remove the task adapters and the gated bidirectional interaction in PDS to verify the effectiveness of task decoupling in PDS, and instead perform 3D convolutions directly in the joint layer to jointly model depth and optical flow. The resulting unified feature is then injected into the U-Net decoder via zero-conv. The results show clear degradations in generation quality and coherence, as well as in the perception metrics. This is because jointly modeling geometry and motion cues within a joint space tends to induce a gradient “tug-of-war”, and injecting such entangled features can disturb the static appearance representations. In contrast, the task adapters in PDS explicitly decouple depth and flow to alleviate gradient conflicts, while the gated bidirectional interaction enables necessary information exchange without sacrificing task-specific modeling. Moreover, the two features are injected into the spatial and temporal layers according to their physical roles, further improving the accuracy and spatiotemporal consistency of 4D scene generation.

paragraphs.en: Toward practical deployment, we propose UniDynamics , a diffusion model conditioned on an event–RGB pair to generate future RGB, depth, and optical flow. We introduce event streams into the diffusion process via an Event Latent Enhancement (ELE) module, using them as complementary cues to RGB that provide effective initial momentum and reliable appearance guidance for scene extrapolation. We further decouple depth and flow in a Perceptual Dynamics Space (PDS) and tightly couple it with the U-Net denoising process to enforce physically plausible and spatiotemporally coherent 4D scene evolution. Experiments on both synthetic and real datasets demonstrate high-quality, temporally coherent appearance prediction and accurate geometric and motion perception.
paragraphs.zh: 为实现实际部署，我们提出了 UniDynamics——一种以事件–RGB 对为条件的扩散模型，用于生成未来的 RGB、深度和光流。 我们通过事件潜在增强（ELE）模块将事件流引入扩散过程，将其作为 RGB 的补充线索，为场景外推提供有效的初始动量和可靠的外观引导。 我们进一步在感知动力学空间（PDS）中解耦深度与光流，并将其与 U-Net 去噪过程紧密耦合，以强制生成物理上合理且时空连贯的 4D 场景演化。 在合成数据集和真实数据集上的实验表明，该方法能够生成高质量、时间连贯的外观预测，并准确感知几何结构与运动。

sents.zh: 我们进一步在感知动力学空间（PDS）中解耦深度与光流，并将其与 U-Net 去噪过程紧密耦合，以强制生成物理上合理且时空连贯的 4D 场景演化。

sents.en: Experiments on both synthetic and real datasets demonstrate high-quality, temporally coherent appearance prediction and accurate geometric and motion perception.
sents.zh: 在合成数据集和真实数据集上的实验表明，该方法能够生成高质量、时间连贯的外观预测，并准确感知几何结构与运动。
